spend: Sum actual_usd_cents once per invoice_line_id; do not add forward commitments.
variance: Sum actual minus forecast for the same year, vendor, currency and version. Drivers reconcile per row.
renewal_priority: High when expiry is within 120 days AND supported critical-app count > 0; otherwise Review when expiry is within 120 days; otherwise Monitor. This is an illustrative rule, not a client-approved policy.
concentration: Distinct supported critical application IDs divided by six critical apps in the selected synthetic portfolio. USES_PORTAL never counts as SUPPORTS.
semantic_layer_note: These are source fixtures plus a definition catalog. They are not a running warehouse, graph database, semantic service or embedding index.
scenario: Preserve baseline. Calculate selected scope gross saving minus transition and retained cost; validate capacity and contract constraints.
